name: ui/native-select
title: NativeSelect
summary: A real <select> in the pill input style (48px, or 32px at `sm`), built from `[value, label]` pairs, with a decorative chevron that never intercepts clicks.

props.name: id
props.description: The <select>'s id, for the caller's <label for>.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; the id when not given.

props.name: options
props.description: `[value, label]` pairs, one <option> each, in order.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected option's value. When no option matches, the browser selects the first.

behaviour: Renders a wrapper <div> (`native-select-wrapper`) holding one native <select> (`native-select`) and an aria-hidden chevron <svg> (`native-select-icon`).
Each `[value, label]` pair becomes an <option>; the one whose value equals `value` is `selected`. The React build also takes <option> children.
`name` defaults to `id`, so the field submits with a plain form.
The chevron is `pointer-events-none`, so a click on it opens the select.
A disabled <select> dims the whole control.
At `size="sm"` the select is 32px (`data-[size=sm]:h-8`), for dense toolbars; the default is the 48px target.

named.description: An explicit name and an extra class.

keyboard: Native: Tab focuses it; arrow keys, type-ahead and Enter/Space choose.
focus: A 2px `--ring` focus ring, offset from `--background`, on keyboard focus.
aria: The caller labels it with a <label for> matching `id`.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills its container's width at every size from 320px.
contract:
contract
  slot is "native-select-wrapper"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/native-select-wrapper"
  select "Zimbabwe" min_height 48
  when default shows option "South Africa"
  when named slot is "native-select-wrapper"
  when named class contains "max-w-xs"
end

checks.say: One native select, its name defaulting to its id.
The option matching value is selected.
With no value, no option is marked selected.
The chevron is decorative and lets clicks through.
The size is carried on the wrapper and the select.

gaps: The Astro build accepts only id, name, options, value, size and class: it cannot mark the select required, disabled or aria-invalid, or describe it with aria-describedby (the React build passes every <select> attribute through).
No option groups or disabled options in the Astro build (React: `NativeSelectOptGroup` and <option> children).
